title: Travel Rates of the UIL Travel Fee Schedule by Activity and Grade — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees, 2026-27
content:
**UIL travel fee schedule, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees — scheduled travel rate.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the scheduled travel rate of the travel fee is 120.00 for the robotics team when the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 06 or above, 80.00 for one-act play when that record shows grade 09 or above, and otherwise the UIL Academic and Robotics Team travel fee of the activity fee catalogue (95.00). The enrollment record is the one Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions keeps for the student and school year.

| Activity | Grade on the enrollment record in status enrolled | Scheduled travel rate |
|---|---|---|
| robotics | 06 through 12 | 120.00 |
| robotics | 02 through 05 | 95.00, the catalogue travel fee |
| one-act play | 09 through 12 | 80.00 |
| one-act play | 02 through 08 | 95.00, the catalogue travel fee |
| UIL academics | any | 95.00, the catalogue travel fee |
| any | no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | 95.00, the catalogue travel fee |

**Points of judgement.** Activity and grade must both match for 120.00 or 80.00. Grade 05 robotics and grade 08 one-act play sit just below their boundaries and take the catalogue travel fee; grade 06 robotics and grade 09 one-act play sit on them and take 120.00 and 80.00.
